description: Five-mode, evidence-bounded operational reporting for supplied redacted records.

routing.when_to_use: Use for Executive Digest, Flash Report, No Material Change, Supervised-Agent Summary, or Maintenance Result from supplied inputs.
when_not_to_use: Do not collect private systems or choose a delivery transport.
Do not replace private health/selfie tracking or immutable legacy content.

required_inputs.name: mode
required_inputs.description: One of the five supported reporting modes

required_inputs.name: window
required_inputs.description: Morning, evening, or custom supplied window

expected_outputs.name: operational_report
expected_outputs.description: Structured mobile report with omitted empty sections and evidence

forbidden_actions: Send, schedule, publish, or select transport
verification_steps: Filter status and omit empty sections
Confirm evidence, uncertainty, and empty effects
completion_criteria: Only verified completion is presented as completed
Final checkpoint does not request another reading
